messages:
alex: Heads up — deploybot just failed the release gate for rc-2026. Canaries in eu-west-1 are blocked.
deploybot: Gate FAIL — SBOM_LICENSE_POLICY \n  release: rc-2026
  image: gcr.io/redwood/runner@sha256:7f3a2b...
  reason: found transitive dependency 'fastzipper'@2.1.0 with license 'QPL-1.0' (policy: allow MIT/Apache2/BSD).
alex: @ben can you triage? is QPL a hard stop?
ben: QPL is on our disallowed list — it's viral copyleft-ish. Legal needs to approve exception.
claire: This popped from a transitive dep via proto-utils@1.4.2 — I can try to bump proto-utils to 1.4.3 which switches to a zlib-licensed variant. Quick diff: 
```
- proto-utils@1.4.2 -> fastzipper@2.1.0 (QPL)
+ proto-utils@1.4.3 -> fastzipper@2.1.1 (zlib)
```
dan: Do we have a 1.4.3 build artifact ready? Canary is already running some traffic, but deploybot flagged it pre-rollout.
erin: Canary workload is small — we can pause canary traffic while we decide. Status: canary pods still live in eu-west-1.
alex: Options: 1) pin proto-utils to 1.4.3 and rebuild + redeploy (preferred), 2) request legal exception (slow), 3) rollback to rc-2025 (fast). Which do we want?
ben: From security POV prefer non-exception. If 1.4.3 is a safe bump and low-risk, go for that.
legal-bot: @ben @alex Filing exception request creates a docket. ETA for review: 2 business days unless accelerated. Provide SBOM diff & intended mitigation.
claire: I can run a local rebuild and smoke test in ~20m. If tests pass, we can push a new image and re-trigger the deploybot gate.
alex: OK Claire, do that. Erin, hold canary traffic. Dan, prepare rollback commands in case rebuild fails.
erin: Pausing canary now -> traffic shifted to steady. :pause_button:
dan: Rollback command ready: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/runner --to-revision=2025` and `deploybot cancel rc-2026-canary`.
claire: Quick note: bumping proto-utils also changes checksum in SBOM. I'll attach the new SBOM to the redeploy request.
claire: rebuild done locally, tests green. pushing image tag rc-2026-fix1 -> gcr.io/redwood/runner@sha256:9c8d4e...
deploybot: New artifact uploaded, re-evaluating gates...
deploybot: Gate PASS — SBOM_LICENSE_POLICY for gcr.io/redwood/runner@sha256:9c8d4e...
alex: Nice. Erin, canary resume?
erin: Resuming canary traffic to eu-west-1. Monitoring with prod-canary dashboard. :eyes:
ben: Security scanned the new artifact; no disallowed licenses. Approving from infra/security side.
legal-bot: Exception request canceled per PR comment.
alex: Thanks everyone. Decision: no exception, performed patch bump and re-deploy. Document this in release notes: note the proto-utils bump to avoid QPL transitive. Claire, add a brief note in rc-2026 release notes and link SBOM diff.
claire: Will do, filing PR to release-notes with SBOM diff link.
alex: Closing thread once PR merged. :white_check_mark:
